item.title: Lee County inmate charged with electronic solicitation of a child
item.description: Bulger is currently in the Lee County Detention Facility with no bond due to unrelated charges.

item.title: Clouds Thursday, showers Friday, another arctic blast this weekend
item.description: Clouds fill the sky Thursday afternoon, but our area remains dry and cool with high temperatures in the low 50s. Clouds may clear at least partially Friday night, with lows falling to near or slightly below freezing (32°).

item.title: Dentists, dental students want dental insurance reform in Alabama
item.description: Dentists and dental students have gathered outside the Alabama State House to lobby for dental insurance reform.

item.title: Should Alabama only offer driver license exams in English?
item.description: A bill in the Alabama Legislature would require all state driver's license exams to be offered only in English.

item.title: U.S. Rep. Shomari Figures discusses school funding in Troy
item.description: U.S. Rep. Shomari Figures (D-Alabama) traveled to Troy to speak on the importance of education and funding for state schools.

item.title: Cusseta man arrested in domestic violence-related incident
item.description: Sheriff Jones says deputies responded to the home in the 1800 block of Lee Road 270 to conduct a welfare check on the family.

item.title: ACTION 8 WEATHER AUTHORITY: Bitter Cold Air Arrives This Weekend
item.description: Single digit wind chills will make it dangerously cold both Saturday and Sunday!

item.title: Alex Golesh comments on college eligibility
item.description: In the wake of Alabama's Charles Bediako being reinstated and fully eligible to play college basketball, Auburn Head Football Coach, Alex Golesh, comments on how this could affect college football.

item.title: Ryan Grubb talks Alabama offense 1-on-1 with Action 8
item.description: Action 8 spoke one-on-one with Alabama offensive coordinator Ryan Grubb as he heads into his second season with the Crimson Tide.

item.title: Democrats, White House strike spending deal that would stop government shutdown
item.description: Democrats and the White House struck a deal to avert a partial government shutdown and temporarily fund the Department of Homeland Security.
